phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing wavelength of the skeletal-lattice pitch (cohort label: pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength)

scale_predecessor.note: No earlier chronospecies is defined. The coarser cellular-tier wavelength used only as a scale comparison, not as copied parameters, is 51 µm.

paleobiology.what_changes_at_this_scale: At λ = 3.43e-05 m the critical wavenumber is k_c = 183183 m^-1. Relative to the 51 µm scale-predecessor, the same anatomical window holds 510/343 = 1.487 times as many wavelengths (bounds 1.48 < ratio < 1.49). Holocene age is unchanged at 0 Ma because the chronoseries has a single extant point.

equations: du/dt = D_u ∇²u + γ (a - u + u² v)
σ(k) = largest eigenvalue of J - k² diag(D_u, D_v)
k_c² = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.planform: Four critical-circle modes |k|=k_c: axial, circumferential, and both diagonals. Orthogonal struts plus diagonal ridges are the Aizenberg et al. 2005 cage, not a hex spot default and not the 51 µm sibling.

amplitude_equations.note: h_orthogonal < g_self so the two orthogonal modes coexist (square lattice) instead of one stripe family winning.

empirical_claims: Aizenberg et al. 2005 (Science 309:275-278) describe seven hierarchical levels and a macroscopic cylindrical square lattice reinforced by diagonal ridges.
Weaver et al. 2007 (J. Struct. Biol. 158:93-106) describe the assembly of that siliceous lattice in Euplectella aspergillum.
Monn et al. 2015 (PNAS 112:4976-4981) describe coaxial silica cylinders on the anchor spicules, thinning from core to periphery. This slot does not fit those layer thicknesses.
The pinned wavelength λ_c = 3.43e-05 m (34.3 µm, reported in the slot brief as 34 µm) is the detail-scale critical wavelength. It is not a measurement quoted from those papers as 34.000 µm.
Turing 1952 supplies the dispersion relation. The sponge does not supply a pigment-ocellus mechanism.

specimen_image.credit: NOAA Okeanos Explorer Program, Gulf of Mexico 2012 Expedition

reported_in_source: Seven-level silica hierarchy and a square lattice with diagonal ridges (Aizenberg et al. 2005).
Lattice assembly in E. aspergillum (Weaver et al. 2007).
Turing dispersion relation and critical wavenumber (Turing 1952).
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg linearisation with a=0.1, b=0.9, D_u=1, D_v=30, γ=1, giving k_c² = 23/60.
Physical calibration λ_c = 3.43e-05 m so k_c = 2π/λ_c = 183183 m^-1.
Four-mode amplitude equations on the critical circle, rendered on a fan of cylinders whose layout echoes the Okeanos photograph.
transfer_boundary: Cohort language of pigment stripes and ocelli is transferred onto a skeletal lattice. The portrait tiles λ_c for visibility; it is not a 1:1 camera micrograph at 34 µm per pore.
does_not_claim: That Euplectella has ocelli or pigment stripes.
That the seven hierarchical levels are reproduced, or that Monn et al. 2015 lamella thicknesses were fitted.
That the 51 µm sibling slot's parameters were reused.
A chronospecies transition: the series is Holocene only (0 Ma).
